title: The Merchandising of Virtue
coreMove: Test moral claims by tracing who pays, who is praised, and who receives the transferred downside.
sourcePressure: Virtue display becomes suspect when the speaker gains reputation while someone else bears the cost of the moral position.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Writing a broad hypocrisy complaint instead of reputational arbitrage under moral cover.

sourceAnchors.name: The Merchandising of Virtue
sourceAnchors.detail: The sidecar supports a focus on virtue displays that keep upside with the speaker and externalize cost or risk.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The merchandising appears when the moral label is sold for applause and the invoice is mailed to someone else.
